definition.n_oracle: log(1/alpha) / KL(Ber(m_target) || Ber(tau)) — Wald-style contextual information yardstick; not a universal lower bound
definition.efficiency_ratio: n_star_q50 / n_oracle (conditional on resolution, as E06's n* quantiles are)
definition.caveats: no minimax or universal optimality claim; no power/type-II constraint; medians rather than E[T]; n* medians are over resolved streams only
